models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B

engines.quant: ROCm; sustained 52-60 output tokens/s, KV cache k8v4 (INT8 K + 4-bit V); the 1250 t/s prompt processing figure in the same post is prefill and is not recorded
ROCm, IQ2_XS; workload split between VRAM and system RAM; ~70 t/s with IQ3_S and still ~66 t/s at 261K context; prompt processing ~1,900 t/s is prefill, not recorded

models.why: Strata runs Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B on a 24GB RX 7900 XTX at 52-87 t/s decode by keeping compressed MoE experts in system RAM and streaming the rest from storage.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: ROCm, IQ4_XS; custom llama.cpp fork streaming the KV cache between VRAM and system RAM; Q4 KV values + Q8 keys; generation at ~20K context (35 t/s at ~200K context); the 658 t/s prefill figure is prompt processing and is not recorded
engines.system_ram_min: 24GB DDR5 (about 16GB used in the reported run)
engines.engine_min_version: custom llama.cpp fork with KV-cache streaming between VRAM and system RAM

models.why: A 16GB RX 9060 XT runs Qwen3.8-27B IQ4_XS at 42.7 tok/s generation at ~20K context by streaming the KV cache into system RAM, dropping to 35 tok/s at ~200K.
